title: Level 2: MQTT fast-path soft leases
description:
## Goal

Level 2: When MQTT is available, workers coordinate claims over the existing optional gossip/overlay (`docs/REALTIME.md`) much faster than Git propagation.

## Protocol sketch

CLAIM → short contention window (seconds, not minutes) → deterministic tie-break → LEASE → renewals → RELEASE/COMPLETE.

MQTT is a **soft** mutex. Partitions, delayed messages, and disconnected clients can still duplicate work. Git remains authoritative durable state; MQTT is faster knowledge of what is happening now.

## Constraints

- Missing MQTT must not break Git-only deployments.
- Reuse the existing envelope/topic model where it fits; do not invent a second bus.

## Depends on

Protocol Gherkin, then Git lease (Git remains fallback).

## Acceptance

Dual-runtime MQTT lease path against Gherkin. When MQTT is off, behavior matches Level 1.
right_now_summary: The MQTT lease fast path and matching tests still need implementation for both runtimes.
